def transform(grid):
    rows=len(grid); cols=len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    counts=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg=counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    special=next((v for v in counts if v not in (0,bg)), None)
    if special is None: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    coords=[(r,c) for r in range(rows) for c in range(cols) if grid[r][c]==special]
    r0=min(r for r,c in coords); c0=min(c for r,c in coords)
    pts=[(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in coords]
    h=max(r for r,c in pts)+1; w=max(c for r,c in pts)+1
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(rows-h+1):
      for c in range(cols-w+1):
        if all(grid[r+dr][c+dc]==0 for dr,dc in pts):
          for dr,dc in pts: out[r+dr][c+dc]=special
    return out
